question: How do I apply for my pension when I retire?

gold_sections.ref: Md. Code, State Personnel and Pensions § 23-401
Md. Code, State Personnel and Pensions § 23-403

nuggets.text: A member submits a written application to the Board of Trustees stating the retirement date.
nuggets.section: Md. Code, State Personnel and Pensions § 23-401
nuggets.quote: the member completes and submits a written application to the Board of Trustees stating the date when the member desires to retire; and

nuggets.text: A former member's retirement begins the first day of the month after the Board receives the application.
nuggets.section: Md. Code, State Personnel and Pensions § 23-403
nuggets.quote: on the first day of the month after the Board of Trustees receives a written application for retirement from the former member.

nuggets.text: No benefits are paid for the period before the completed application.
nuggets.section: Md. Code, State Personnel and Pensions § 23-403
nuggets.quote: A former member who retires under this section may not receive benefits for the period before the former member submitted a completed application for retirement to the Board of Trustees.
